data.reply: Hi, thanks for reaching out and sorry for the trouble. The 'Domain not allowed' error usually indicates a configuration issue within your CloudDesk Admin Console. Please navigate to the 'SSO & Identity' settings for Google SSO and review the 'Allowed Domains' list. Ensure that any missing domains that should be permitted to log in via Google SSO are added to this list. [T-2308] Let us know if that does not resolve it.
